type.description: The workspace provider name as defined in `GET /workspace_providers`.

details.description: A status message (e.g. error message) or any other free-text information about the workspace.

oneOf.title: Unavailable
oneOf.description: The workspace is not available, e.g. because it's still provisioning it or the back-end can't connect to it / lost the connection / has been deleted externally, ...

workspace_description.description:
A description that describes the workspace.

[CommonMark 0.29](http://commonmark.org/) syntax MAY be used for rich
text representation.

workspace_properties.description: Any additional metadata of the workspace provided by the workspace provider. The structure is not specified by the API.

workspace_title.description: A short title for the workspace.

workspace_url.description: The URL of the actual workspace, e.g. a bucket URL.
